scope: FITLOOP V61 product IDs 9, 10, 11 gallery background removal

records.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: production ecommerce gallery photo. Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Remove ONLY the studio backdrop, floor and cast shadows, replacing them with real fully transparent alpha. Preserve the exact photographed person and garments, pose, body crop, camera angle, framing, position, proportions, denim wash, texture, logos, rhinestones, frayed hems, hangtags, hands, skin and shoes. Do not recompose, recrop, resize the subject, add missing body parts, redesign the product, smooth fabric or change colors. Keep the same 2:3 portrait composition and relative subject placement; do not fill the crop with extra content. Subject appearance should remain as close as possible to the input. Maintain natural fine edges with no pale/gray halo; transparent space includes gaps between legs/arms. No replacement background, gradient, floor, shadow, extra objects or text. Output transparent PNG.
